policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Venous and Arterial Thrombosis Testing

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Plasma testing for protein C deficiency (CPT code 85302, CPT code 85303), protein S deficiency (CPT code 85305, CPT code 85306) and antithrombin III deficiency (CPT code 85300, CPT code 85301) IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following situations: – Acute coronary syndromes including myocardial infarction – Any deep venous thrombosis – Arterial ischemic stroke – Deep phlebothrombosis in pregnancy – Disseminated intravascular coagulation, also known as defibrination syndrome – Pulmonary embolism – Relatives of individuals with deep venous thrombosis • Plasma testing for protein C deficiency (CPT code 85302, CPT code 85303) or protein S deficiency (CPT code 85305, CPT code 85306) IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following situations: – Neonatal purpura fulminans – Warfarin-induced skin necrosis • Venous thrombosis risk testing (CPT codes 85300-85303, CPT code 85305, CPT code 85306) for superficial venous thrombosis, including superficial thrombophlebitis and varicosities, IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • The activated protein C resistance assay (CPT code 85307) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Multi-gene panel testing (CPT code 0278U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
